summary: Upexi, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 7, 2026, disclosing only that Chief Strategy Officer Brian Rudick will attend three October 2026 investor conferences: the Maxim Growth Summit (Oct 12-14, New York), the Webull Emerging Innovative Companies Webinar (Oct 14, 1:00 PM ET, virtual), and the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event (Oct 19-21, Los Angeles, presenting Oct 20 at 3:00 PM PT). No transaction, capital event, or governance change is disclosed. No deal terms, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock applies; watch only for any substantive announcement tied to the conference appearances.
